axeViolations.description: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space
axeViolations.help: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space

nodes.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size because it is partially obscured (smallest space is 18.6px by 48px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 18.6px instead of at least 24px.
